profile.name: Frédéric Crousaz
profile.headline: Event Officer / Coordinateur d'événements & opérations
profile.summary: Professionnel de la gestion opérationnelle d'événements avec cinq années d'expérience dans l'organisation de grandes conférences internationales, la mise en place des inscriptions et la conclusion de contrats fournisseurs jusqu'à la livraison sur site. Expérience auprès d'organisations internationales (IUCN, CICR, Swiss-African Business Circle). Bonne connaissance de la gestion des plates-formes d'inscription, du suivi des budgets, de la coordination des sponsors, exposants et lieux, et du suivi d'un programme à jour. Disponible pour les déplacements sur site.

jobs.title: External Service/Merchandising Employee (m/f/d) 80% to 100% for the Lausanne - Geneva Region
jobs.description: We are a dynamic company (SME) based in Rossens, Bülach as well as Geneva, specialising for over 80 years in the import and distribution of non-food items in Switzerland. To complete our merchandising team, we are looking for a External Service/Merchandising Employee (m/f/d) 80% to 100% for the Lausanne - Geneva Region You will be responsible for the placement of merchandise in the sales outlets of our clients in French-speaking Switzerland, especially the region between Lausanne and the city of Geneva. Suitable place of residence between Lausanne and Geneva Tasks: Carry out visits to retail sales outlets for our clients, notably Marchon as well as other clients in the tobacco sector. Order goods and stock shelves in sales outlets. Replace and install advertising materials. Place products on shelves according to predefined planograms, check the layouts and adjust if necessary. Ensure cover during holidays as well as troubleshooting in neighbouring regions. We expect: Good language skills corresponding to the relevant sector. Driving licence. Great flexibility and autonomy, as this activity involves numerous car journeys, regular visits to clients and sometimes irregular hours. Saturdays and Sundays are free. Basic computer skills, especially in using a computer and a tablet for orders, layout checks and statistics. Friendly, helpful and reliable personality. Good ability to understand and assimilate quickly. We offer: We offer a pleasant workplace Flexible working hours Modern and efficient work tools Salary range: according to education/experience/age Start date: immediate Application dossier to be sent to: Olivera Balasevic, Merchandising Manager, +41 79 444 26 90 or Petra Schaller, HR, Route de Montena 67, 1728 Rossens, +41 26 460 88 81

jobs.title: After-Sales Service Group Leader – Geneva
jobs.description: For over 100 years, our family business has been developing customised solutions in the construction and installation of lifts. With 120 employees, Ascenseurs Menétrey SA continues to combine tradition, innovation and proximity. In view of an upcoming retirement, we are looking for our future:   After-Sales Service Group Leader – Geneva Based at our Geneva office, you are a true link between the field teams and our clients and hold a central position within our after-sales service activity. Available and attentive, you set the course for your team and support them daily in their tasks, with a constant focus on quality and customer satisfaction. If uniting a team around a goal, tackling operational challenges and actively contributing to the success of our company motivates you, then this position is made for you.   As a group leader, you are responsible for the following tasks: Supervise and support a team of 10 after-sales service and special works technicians (repairs) Ensure the administrative and human follow-up of your team (hours, holidays, annual meetings, etc.) Manage your group’s activity: Monitor and analyse performance and quality indicators (failure rate, visit rate, recurring faults, etc.) to guide the team towards achieving its objectives Maintain close collaboration with our technical sales staff: Preparing quotes, managing priorities, client communication, etc. Provide your technical expertise and support technicians in complex situations Promote a safety culture within your team by actively contributing to its dissemination, raising awareness among your team and applying good QSE practices Actively contribute to the development of work processes and your team’s skills Occasionally prepare offers in support of the technicians Your background and talents: You hold a qualification in a technical field (mechanics, electricity, automation, etc.) and have several years of proven experience in the lift sector With strong leadership skills, you are recognised for your ability to unite and develop a team, combining high standards, relational courage, listening and kindness Proactive, you show initiative and are solution-oriented Autonomous and organised by nature, you manage your priorities effectively Thanks to your calm and pragmatic character, you know how to adapt to unforeseen events Your place of residence allows you to reach Geneva within 45 minutes at most You hold a valid driving licence We offer you: A stable and rewarding position within a human-sized family business A working environment based on trust and collaboration, where mutual support among colleagues is a daily reality A fulfilling corporate environment where your ideas are heard and where you can actively contribute to improvement projects Flexible working conditions, with genuine attention to work-life balance, including bridging days offered on public holidays

jobs.title: Watchmaker Operator / Watchmaker / Watch Services Specialist 100% (m/f/d) - Geneva
jobs.description: Discover Bucherer Worldwide, Bucherer embodies excellence in the world of exceptional watches and refined jewellery. Thanks to a unique combination of tradition, innovation and artisanal expertise, the House has established itself as an essential reference in the market. Present in more than 100 boutiques around the world, we welcome a discerning clientele every day. With passion and impeccable hospitality, we offer much more than products: a true experience. More than 2,000 committed employees share the same ambition: to convey their fascination for exceptional pieces and to make every encounter with our clients a privileged moment. Your role within our house: You welcome and advise our demanding Swiss and international clientele within our After-Sales Service (ASS). You ensure an exemplary image of Bucherer through the excellence of your work and service. You take charge of first-level watch maintenance activities. You perform simple adjustments on watches and battery replacements, resizing of straps. You ensure the administrative follow-up of ASS files, respecting quality standards in terms of file completion and information in accordance with our procedures. You handle logistics, shipping, tracking and receipt of watches. You are responsible for ordering and receiving supplies. You ensure impeccable information flow between colleagues and actively support them. Your profile: You hold at least a Federal Professional Certificate (AFP) as a watchmaking operator or a Watchmaker (CFC). Ideally, you have several years of experience within an After-Sales Service (ASS). You stand out for your professional rigour and attention to detail that makes a difference for our clientele. You have a keen sense of service and exemplary customer orientation. As a native French speaker, you have excellent command of English; German is an asset. You are comfortable with managing computer systems. You possess a strong sense of responsibility, excellent team spirit and flexibility. Your appearance is neat and professional. Why join Bucherer? Because for us, it is much more than a job: it is passion that makes the difference. Our employees share a commitment to artisanal excellence, impeccable service and a true team spirit. We combine the heritage of Swiss tradition with an international openness, in a working environment where quality, collaboration and high standards are at the heart of everything we do. At Bucherer, we encourage individual development, cultivate innovation and offer everyone the opportunity to reveal their potential, together, within a team that inspires and unites. At Bucherer, you particularly benefit from the following advantages: 40-hour work week At least 27 days of holiday per year Flexible working models, with the possibility of remote work when the role allows Preferential purchase conditions on watches and jewellery Particularly advantageous benefits on the occasion of the birth of a child Attractive coverage in terms of pension fund and social insurances We look forward to receiving your application. Your Human Resources team Bucherer AG

jobs.title: Care Assistant M/F – Home Care | Regular Assignments, Temporary and On-Call | Geneva & La Côte Vaudoise
jobs.description: Accès personnel recruits and recognises all talents! For our clients based in Geneva La Côte Vaudoise, we are looking for a Home Care Assistant (M/F)           As soon as possible. See you very soon! Care Assistant M/F – Home Care | Regular Assignments, Temporary and On-Call | Geneva & La Côte Vaudoise Your mission: Offer personalised care adapted to the needs of the beneficiaries; Provide hygiene, comfort and support care in accordance with best practices; Carry out a care round independently within a defined geographical area; Ensure the traceability of care and the transmission of essential information for continuity of care; Participate in assessing the needs of beneficiaries and report any changes in their condition; Collaborate with various stakeholders and the multidisciplinary team; Intervene in the context of regular assignments, occasional replacements or urgent on-call missions; Contribute to maintaining the autonomy and well-being of people supported at home. Your profile: You hold a Care Assistant diploma or an equivalent qualification; You have at least 2 years of experience as a Care Assistant; Ideally, you have prior successful experience in home care; You have good knowledge of the Geneva and/or Vaud care network, an asset; You are organised, autonomous, flexible and adaptable; You are comfortable with IT tools; You have a personal vehicle (an asset) or are mobile within your area of intervention; You can manage emergency situations with professionalism and composure; You demonstrate strong interpersonal skills, empathy and discretion; You enjoy teamwork while being capable of working independently; Your criminal record is clean; You are available for regular, occasional or on-call assignments according to your availability. Why join us? Opportunities within specialised home care structures in the cantons of Geneva and Vaud (La Côte); Varied assignments adapted to your availability: part-time, replacements, temporary or urgent interventions; Work environment favouring proximity, autonomy and quality of care; Care rounds in defined geographical areas, by car, bike or on foot; Personalised support and regular follow-up of your activity; Possibility to sustainably develop your experience in the field of home care. If you identify with this profile and wish to join a dynamic structure with a caring and close-knit team, please send us your application accompanied by your CV and any other documents necessary for the assessment of your file (diplomas, certificates, cover letter, criminal record, etc.). We look forward to contacting you as soon as possible. See you very soon!

jobs.title: Live Marketing Manager, Trade Fairs & Events 80 - 100 %
jobs.description: You build the stage on which our brand becomes tangible. Trade fairs and events in Switzerland and internationally, right in the heart of the motorcycle and mountain bike scene: You ensure that the iXS brand convinces in live marketing. ABOUT iXS We commit to protect. You commit to ride. Since 1979, we have been developing highly functional protective clothing for motorcycles and mountain bikes in Sursee and are represented worldwide. We have been awarded multiple times with the Design & Innovation Award and are closely connected with athletes and key opinion leaders from the motorcycle and mountain bike world globally. iXS is part of the hostettler group. THIS IS WHAT IT'S ABOUT At trade fairs and events, dealers, distributors, media, as well as end consumers, experience our brand up close. A strong presence is created together: marketing managers develop goals, messages, and content. Sales, product management, graphics, partners, and service providers contribute their expertise. You turn this into a presentation that works and hold the reins from the initial planning to the debriefing. Additionally, you support the marketing team with logistics and administration, from samples for our sponsored athletes to the invoice from the stand builder. WHAT TO EXPECT An evolving event mix: We continuously review which trade fairs and events are worthwhile and test new formats. Your experience and ideas flow directly into this Two worlds, two target groups: You move within the motorcycle and mountain bike scenes and implement each appearance so that it resonates within its scene A job with seasonal dynamics: During intense phases, you are on the road, including weekends. Quieter times are used for planning and further development Collaboration as a success factor: You report to the Head of Marketing and work closely with internal departments, team members, partners, and our distributors at home and abroad, because we believe success is created together Your Tasks You plan, organise, and implement trade fairs, dealer and brand events, as well as scene events in Switzerland and internationally, independently from registration to dismantling, and are present at the most important occasions You manage external partners, agencies, and service providers You implement product and brand presentations together with internal departments You support the sales team at sales meetings and in the showrooms You measure the success of each event and improve our appearances from time to time You organise the shipping of product samples to athletes and media as well as logistics for shoots at home and abroad You procure displays, POS materials, giveaways, and merchandise, manage stock and inventory, and keep budgets, offers, and invoices under control Your Profile At least 3 years of experience with trade fairs and events, ideally international and in the two-wheeler, sports, or outdoor industry, as well as training or further education in event or marketing You keep an overview of several projects simultaneously and are familiar with budgets, service providers, and logistics abroad including customs You have an eye for spatial presentation and appear confident towards internal and external partners as well as within your team Collaboration is important to you: You involve other departments, partners, and service providers early and pull together with them You are hands-on, help with setup and dismantling, and remain calm when things get hectic You communicate confidently in German and English and are proficient with Microsoft 365 and project management tools. French and Italian are a plus You enjoy working in the office as well as on the road, including weekends during the season You hold a category B driving licence We are especially pleased if you yourself ride a motorcycle or mountain bike and know the scene from the inside. What We Offer A versatile key role at a Swiss brand with a history since 1979 Trade fairs and events in Switzerland and internationally, close to the motorcycle and mountain bike scene A dedicated marketing team with flat hierarchies An innovative company in a future-oriented market environment and a tangible team spirit Attractive workplace in Sursee with free parking facilities Promotion of personal development including support for internal and external training Above-average paid absence days as well as 16 weeks maternity and 3 weeks paternity leave Flexible working hours model, 5 weeks holiday (6 weeks from age 50 and/or in a managerial role) and continuously paid public holidays Possibility of home office and holiday purchase as well as flexible part-time positions Attractive employee discounts on all products of the hostettler group Various discounts with partners (insurance, fleet discounts, courses, tickets, etc.) Diverse events and activities, such as our legendary hoschi-days Are you interested? Then we look forward to your online application! #hostettlerjobs   We do without a classic cover letter. Instead, please answer the following question: Tell us about a trade fair or event where something went differently at short notice than planned. What did you do, who did you involve, and what do you do differently since then?   Applications from recruitment agencies will not be considered.

As one of the largest event caterers in Switzerland, Wassermann & Company plans, organises and caters events for clients from sport, culture and business. These include FC Basel, the Swiss Indoors, the Baloise Session, Art Basel and numerous concerts. We operate in the lively environment of event catering at top locations in Basel and Zurich – from the trade fair to the Congress Centre, to the Musical Theatre or Stadtcasino. You accompany enquiries from individual consultation and offer preparation to successful contract conclusion and then take over the administrative event coordination. In doing so, you work closely with our operational teams and ensure a smooth handover of the events. You maintain existing customer relationships, identify additional sales potential and actively contribute to the success of Wassermann Catering with your initiative and your sense for the needs of our clients. jobs.title: Sales Assistant Beverages & Events (m/f/d)
jobs.description: The LANDI cooperatives support Swiss farmers in the economic development of their businesses. Together with the brands Volg, TopShop and AGROLA, the LANDI cooperatives also supply the population in rural areas of Switzerland with food, everyday goods and energy. The Landi cooperatives are successfully active in the Bern region. To strengthen our LANDI store team in Laupen, we are looking for a sales assistant for beverages & events to start immediately or by arrangement. Sales Assistant Beverages & Events (m/f/d) These tasks will inspire you Whether club festival, company event, trade exhibition, village festival or private party: with our event and beverage service, we support customers in the successful execution of their events. As we are further developing and expanding this business area, we are looking for an initiative, customer-oriented and committed personality. With us, you can expect not only a varied range of tasks but also the opportunity to contribute your own ideas and actively shape the future success of the event and beverage service. Consulting and support of private, club, company and municipal customers Management of the beverage section in the store Sale of beverages as well as event and festival services Preparation and follow-up of offers Organisation and coordination of customer orders Picking of beverages and rental materials Provision and checking of customer orders Assistance with deliveries as well as setup and dismantling of event materials Support at events and assistance to our customers on site Active participation in the LANDI store and serving our customers Inventory management, shelf maintenance and product presentation Assistance with seasonal sales campaigns and promotions Assistance with warehouse management Building and maintaining long-term customer relationships Active involvement in the further development of the event and beverage service We look forward to this profile Enjoyment of sales and customer consulting Independent, reliable and structured way of working Organisational talent and flexibility Practical skills and willingness to pitch in Interest in events, festivals and celebrations Enjoyment of club life as well as contact with clubs, municipalities and local organisations Open and communicative personality Experience in sales, event sector, logistics or a comparable activity is an advantage Driving licence category B (BE advantageous) LANDI cooperatives 80-100% Position Employee Type of employment Permanent Professional field Sales / Customer consulting Questions about the application process Susanne Schranz Personnel Administration Officer 058 434 26 07 Questions about the position Sven Röthlisberger Management +41 58 434 26 00 Discover your benefits Training and further education We invest in the development of our employees. A broad internal training offer is open to all, and we support external further education. Attractive holiday regulations Our holiday regulations guarantee all employees at least 5 weeks of holiday. For apprentices and employees under 20 years, it is 6 weeks. In addition, unpaid leave is possible. Family time Mothers receive 100 percent of their insured salary during the 14 to 16 weeks of maternity leave. The other parent enjoys 3 weeks of family time with full pay. Insurance benefits We secure our employees with above-average social and pension benefits and offer special conditions on supplementary insurance with various health insurers for their entire family. Discounts and rebates Our employees benefit, among other things, from discounts on the purchase of furniture and new cars, special conditions on private insurance as well as discounted mobile subscriptions for themselves and their families. Anniversary gift Every five years we thank our employees for their loyalty and great commitment, either with a financial bonus or additional holiday days. Our application process With a click on "Apply now" you can easily submit your application documents by e-mail. After careful review of all applications, a first selection is made and feedback is given. If a dossier convinces, one or two interviews take place to get to know each other personally. If it fits both sides, a binding offer follows. Then it is: Welcome to the team – to a successful future together! About us LANDI Bern-West is an agricultural cooperative with a 130-year history. With 75 employees at locations in Laupen, Thörishaus and Rosshäusern, we are an important trading and service partner for the region. We are part of the fenaco-LANDI group, which also includes other well-known brands such as UFA, RAMSEIER, Volg and AGROLA.
